one_sentence_story: A single source artifact sends one luminous thread through a transparent context capsule, resolves into a torus family with a cusp hexagonal fibre, and closes an S6 paper claim only when a world trace is visibly attached.

beats.name: source artifact
beats.causal_move: A warm paper-like source tile is placed on the left basalt island; one small amber mark leaves its lower edge.
beats.motion: The source tile settles once; the amber mark is the only moving element after the label appears.

beats.name: luminous evidence stream
beats.causal_move: The amber mark becomes a thin, braided evidence stream and travels toward the centre without spawning a second source.
beats.motion: A single stroke is revealed left-to-right; old portions remain fixed as the camera eases forward.

beats.name: transparent Context Capsule
beats.causal_move: The stream enters a glass capsule; the capsule makes one hidden junction legible as a cyan point, while the source and stream remain visible.
beats.motion: The capsule fades from 0 to 1 opacity and the cyan point appears only at the junction; no dashboard chrome enters.

beats.name: torus family and cusp fibre
beats.causal_move: The cyan junction folds into three nested torus rings and ends in one hexagonal cusp fibre, making the evidence shape continuous rather than decorative.
beats.motion: The same cyan point traces the rings; the six-sided cusp is drawn last and then held still.

beats.name: closed S6 claim
beats.causal_move: A dark claim plaque stays visibly unlatched until a receipt tab carrying the world trace docks to the cusp; only then does the plaque close.
beats.motion: All geometry freezes except the receipt tab; the final frame holds the attached trace and the still-open source-to-world path.

caption_script: A source is not yet a world trace.
Follow one evidence stream through its context.
The shape can persist while the interpretation changes.
The S6 statement is a paper claim, not consensus fact.
Close it only when the world trace is attached.

manim_plan.coordinate_system: Three-quarter orthographic stage; source at (-5.3,-0.4,0), capsule at (0,0,0), torus family at (2.6,0.2,0), claim plaque at (5.1,-0.9,0).
construction: Build the source tile, basalt islands, and plaque from fixed polygons; use no procedural texture or random particles.
Construct the stream as one ParametricFunction with a deterministic cubic Bezier centreline and two fixed-width offset strokes.
Construct the capsule as four translucent Line polygons and reveal the cyan junction with a single FadeIn.
Construct torus rings from fixed ParametricFunction samples at radii 1.0, 1.35, and 1.7; rotate each by a fixed angle only during B4.
Construct the cusp as a regular hexagon with six fixed vertices; morph the final stream endpoint into its centre.
Construct the receipt tab as a labelled rounded rectangle; animate one Transform from its parked position to the cusp notch, then change the plaque stroke from amber to green.
manim_plan.accessibility: Every label is rendered as real text; dense claim text is shown during a still frame with no competing motion; reduced-motion mode keeps all objects and swaps travel for opacity changes.

falsifier: If the source pointer, context boundary, or world trace is missing, the receipt tab must not dock and the S6 plaque must remain visibly unlatched; a final green closure without that trace would falsify this film's causal story.
